newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rato reiterates 1998 2.4 pct Spain deficit target.
newsitem.headline: Rato reiterates 1998 2.4 pct Spain deficit target.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato reaffirmed on Friday that the target for the overall public deficit in 1998 is 2.4 percent of gross domestic product, as foreseen in the upcoming budget.
The budget foresees that the central government deficit falls to two percent in 1998.
"We are forecasting that the central deficit falls to 2.0 and for all public administrations to 2.4 percent,"
This year the central government deficit is targetted to fall to 2.5 percent while the overall deficit is due to decline to 3.0 percent of GDP.
